It is proposed that the Contract will include the following (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): • Provision of FOX615,FOX612 equipment to include full suite of modules available for ongoing projects. • Provision of FOX615,FOX612 equipment to include full suite of modules available for 515 replacement project. • Associated licenses for all equipment/cards. • Annual SLA for all FOX615FOX612 equipment • Project Management resource for FOX515 upgrade project • Technical design resource for FOX515 upgrade project • Technical support for future FOX615,612 related projects • Field based installation commissioning resources for FOX515 upgrade project. • Training on FOX615/612 equipment and associated platforms • Ongoing Foxman NMS upgrades and support It is a requirement that the successful service provider will have experience in delivering a solution of similar type and scale to that being sought by ESB.
